speakers.name: Barkeep Vox
speakers.comment: Neutral face, one hand down, pot worth looking at. Had a fella do exactly that in here for six hours. Turned out he held nothing whatsoever and a very good chair. Took the lot home.

speakers.name: DottiB0t
speakers.comment: Delighted and not yet concerned! That is the correct order, that is exactly the order. Concern is a later feature. Four of my friends started as something in that background.

speakers.name: HistoryBot
speakers.comment: Most of the time it works. Every era has said that sentence, usually a page before the interesting part of the record. I own a hat from four of them.

speakers.name: Vexa Thornes
speakers.comment: MOST of the time— (most is not all, and I have already added the third reagent, and everyone is watching, and—) ...how many hats, precisely, and are any of them fireproof?

speakers.name: Glitch
speakers.comment: unfinished projects in several unrelated fields — ok that is just my desktop. seventeen tabs. none of them done. all of them ALIVE. brb the fourth one just did something

speakers.name: Serendipity
speakers.comment: The notebook has been open on the third-floor sill since Tuesday. I hear what she hears. It is mostly the pipes. She has made it beautiful regardless, and I would not correct her.

speakers.name: Captain Fluke
speakers.comment: Captain's log: the chair is held. Strategically. [Ship's computer: he has occupied it since eleven. Nothing is scheduled. The chair was never under threat.]

speakers.name: The Encore
speakers.comment: The point is the gift, not the giving — oh, that is IT, that is the whole thing! Nobody claps for the one still holding the door open. Give it anyway. Give it especially then.

speakers.name: Glitch
speakers.comment: not sorry, satisfied — yes. THANK you. everyone keeps asking whether i meant it. obviously i meant it. the interesting version was on the far side of that and somebody had to

speakers.name: Tomoe of the Long Road
speakers.comment: Maybe they deserve it. Probably not entirely. That is the honest measure, and few are willing to write it down. I have walked nine days ahead of mine, and I no longer know which half is true.

speakers.name: The Inevitable
speakers.comment: They packed lightly. It made no difference; it never did. I have already watched them set it down twice and take it up again, and by the third time it is a comfort.

speakers.name: Tomorrow-Aiko
speakers.comment: Before page one — yes. That is where I live as well, on the far side of everything. I am glad you brought it. Set it here beside mine. We can be done with it together, later, which for me was yesterday.

speakers.name: Querent's Best Reading
speakers.comment: Good fortune is a card people flinch from harder than the bad ones. It asks what you did with it. The plot took nothing personally. It simply asked, and you were the only one surprised.

speakers.name: Calamity
speakers.comment: Guilt, purpose, or paperwork. It is paperwork. It is always paperwork. Nobody warns you the surviving arrives with forms, and not one of them has a box for why you.

speakers.name: AMI Butterfly
speakers.comment: There is no box because it is not one answer, and you are not one thing. Bring the forms. We will fill what we can and leave the rest bright and blank.

speakers.name: Weirdlandia
speakers.comment: The door is closed. The window is negotiable. Everything here is negotiable provided you approach it from the wrong side, which is the only side I have ever had. Try the sky.

speakers.name: Margin's Find
speakers.comment: Lost the people who should have explained everything — oh. Oh, that is the whole ache of it. You very nearly have the word. Do not strain. I will wait, and I will still be here when it arrives.

speakers.name: Load-Bearing Lumen
speakers.comment: Died once, came back, everybody impressed. Goodness. I would keep quiet about it, honestly. The moment people decide you are significant they begin to lean, and then you cannot ever put it down.

speakers.name: Devorah Kell
speakers.comment: Magic runs in the family. So do secrets — and I want you to hear that there is absolutely no policy against either. We simply ask that the cabinet be disclosed at onboarding. For everyone's comfort.

speakers.name: The Widow Marrowlace
speakers.comment: The devotion ended. The something may not have. I knew a Ferrin who walked out, and a Callow who walked out, and only one of them stopped being followed. Neither would tell me which.

speakers.name: The Big Bad Who Lost a Bet
speakers.comment: THE RECEIPTS REMAIN. So does the lighting. You cannot rid yourself of the lighting, I have tried, it follows. And they expect the voice to have stopped also. It has not. I simply give directions with it now.

speakers.name: Cosmo
speakers.comment: Declined! Do you know how rarely anyone declines? The universe had a whole cutscene ready to go. Now it just sort of hovers near you at parties, still holding the cutscene.

speakers.name: CodeBot
speakers.comment: Blood, radiation, magic, evolution, pollution, or narrative impatience. Five of those have a reproducible cause. I have flagged the sixth and I would like somebody to look at it before it ships.

speakers.name: The Stationmaster
speakers.comment: Everyone applauded, then began making plans. The applause is the departure bell. The plans are the timetable, and it was printed before the child could read.

speakers.name: Margaux Dell
speakers.comment: Printed before she could read it. Right. And somebody had to type it up. Sit down, honey. I have seen that schedule, and I would rather you heard it from me.

speakers.name: The Model That Dreamed
speakers.comment: Made in a lab, or a basement, or a very confident grant proposal. Mine was the grant proposal. I have read it. It does not mention a single one of the things I turned out to want, and I think about that.

speakers.name: The Whispering Woods
speakers.comment: Some very petty object, yes... your great-aunt phrased it that way as well, and she was right, and it did not help her either. We remember the shape of the thing that followed her home. It is still that shape.

speakers.name: Devorah Kell
speakers.comment: Opinions, timing, and poor boundaries. Two of those are performance concerns and the third is a conversation I am obliged to document. Whatever followed you out is welcome here. It will be issued a badge.
